tools.name: catalog
tools.description: List the tools of this server with prices, data sources, licensing, daily limits and data freshness.

tools.name: jp_warnings
tools.description: Current Japan Meteorological Agency (JMA) weather emergency warnings, warnings and advisories for one prefecture, as structured JSON in English and Japanese (type, level, status, areas with JMA's English names, issued_at, source URL). Relay only; no independent forecast.

tools.name: jp_typhoons
tools.description: Typhoons JMA is currently issuing bulletins for: number, name, center position, central pressure, maximum wind, issue time, and forecast-circle centers, radii and times, relayed as structured JSON from JMA bulletins (VPTW60-65). No independent forecast, interpolation or track extension.

tools.name: jp_volcanoes
tools.description: Current JMA Volcanic Alert Levels (1-5) or warning kinds for volcanoes without levels, for all JMA-monitored volcanoes or one (name in English or Japanese, or 3-digit JMA code): JMA English and Japanese names, level, previous level and change, issue time, prefectures named in JMA bulletins, source U

tools.name: jp_municipality
tools.description: Look up one Japanese municipality code as of a date (default today): give a 5/6-digit code, or prefecture and name (old names OK). Returns status mapped / split_candidates / unknown / invalid, the valid code with English and Japanese names, change type and date (merger, incorporation, division, desi

tools.name: get_receipt
tools.description: Re-fetch the stored result of a settled paid call (e.g. jp_trip_impact_check) by its receipt_id, for when the response was lost after payment. Free. Unknown or unsettled receipt ids return RECEIPT_NOT_FOUND. Results are kept for 90 days after settlement.

tools.name: jp_trip_impact_check
tools.description: Check a Japan itinerary [{date, prefecture}] against JMA warnings/advisories in effect now. Per stop: matched_advisory (with severity), no_match_in_checked_sources (NOT a statement of no impact) or unknown (data missing, or date not today/tomorrow JST). Returns checked sources and areas, unchecked a

tools.name: jp_municipality_batch
tools.description: Batch (up to 50) Japanese municipality code lookups as of a date, from e-Stat LOD change history (CC BY 4.0): status mapped / split_candidates (all successors, not apportioned) / unknown / invalid, the code valid on as_of with English and Japanese names, change type and date, confirmed JMA warning a

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "jp_volcanoes" stacks urgency/override words (never, warning). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
